limitations: Horizontal periodic neutral carriers at one size/camera matrix only;12 signals/2 noise conditions/4 CFA layouts/4 draws. Signal presence/frequency is known only to the diagnostic. This cannot establish natural-texture recovery, SOTA, convergence or GPU FP16 behavior. Retained V43 has different training history; only fresh-none/fresh-dino-s form a matched trained comparison.

input_observability.scope: Input-only companion on exactly the same384 seeded analytic observations as the model response probe, cropped to the same160px ROI. CPU FP64 WLS on raw CFA; no model, training, held-out image or inference calibration.
input_observability.method: Four phase DC nuisances and a common known horizontal cos/sin carrier in physical camera units. Weights use clean analytic shot/read plus ADC16/.03-black quantization-variance approximation. Coefficient covariance is inverse weighted normal matrix.
input_observability.limitations: Frequency, background, clean variance and carrier family are oracle information for this diagnostic. Approximate known-carrier SNR is not a bound for a generic denoiser, proof of natural-texture recoverability, or an exact confidence interval under clipped/quantized Poisson noise. It only checks that a coherent carrier has measurable evidence within the selected ROI.

execution_wrapper.note: Complete summary/per-case/crops and final completion line were written before the command wrapper returned143. Cause of termination after publication was not isolated; do not describe this as a clean CLI exit. No rerun of all neural cases was performed.

decision: No checkpoint/default promotion. Known-carrier diagnostic exposes substantial weak-contrast suppression, while stronger carriers survive. Prepare a separate optional weak-procedural-source trial with unchanged photo/flat quotas, model/loss/noise/optimizer settings and full real-photo validation. It does not prove natural-texture recovery or irrecoverable/fully recoverable information bounds.
